page: UpCloud PREMIUM-80xCPU-512GB is a high-capacity virtual server built on the KVM hypervisor. It features 80 vCPUs mapped to 80 physical cores of an AMD EPYC 9575F processor running at 2.0 GHz, utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 512.0 GB of RAM, providing 6.4 GB of memory per core. Local storage is bundled with a 500 GB SSD, and the configuration includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

Performance benchmarks show top-tier capabilities in multi-core processing and data decompression. The server achieves top 10% placement in stress-ng multi-core CPU performance, Geekbench multi-core, and bzip3 decompression tests. It also demonstrates strong performance in database operations and static web serving. However, memory performance is more moderate, with the PassMark memory score landing in the average tier. Additionally, while prompt processing for small and medium language models is average, text generation speeds are weak, falling into the bottom 25%.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the server offers high resource density with 80 physical cores and a substantial 512 GB memory footprint. A key architectural tradeoff is the shared CPU allocation, which may introduce performance variability under sustained peak loads compared to dedicated instances. The server is highly suited for parallel processing tasks, software compilation, database operations, and high-throughput web serving, but is less optimal for real-time LLM text generation.
